authorization: User replied ok go ahead to establishing convergence across prespecified initializations, then tracking and noisy rate sensing. This is a private bounded new numerical study.
rationale: Fixed80s training replaces20s because prior observed-covariance gaps and generic initial overlap showed delayed convergence at some sites. No outcome-dependent training extension or seed selection. Prior successful and failed records remain unchanged.

physical_protocol.plant: Same periodic32-point spectral Burgers plant and RK4 with continuous piecewise-linear u, fixed physical coefficients throughout. No new exogenous coefficient drift or unmodeled clock dependence.
physical_protocol.control: Same pre-update learned-row completion, measured-state feedback, input guard and clip as prior paired study. Both arms act on own physical trajectories.

sensing.ideal: Exact observed w and ideal simulated w_t; spatial channels from observed w. The ideal rate remains an explicit sensor assumption.
sensing.causal: Measured w only (plus known applied u); quadratic least squares with uniform weights on r_j=(t_j-t_current)/.10 over all samples fromt_current-.10 tot_current; derivative is fitted r coefficient/.10. No future/centered samples or true-rate fallback.
sensing.startup: At0.10s causal rate/context first valid; after another.05s valid context history, first causal secant/learning at0.15s. Known training probe drives plant from0 independently. Ideal first learning at0.05s. Startup raw observations retained and invalid rates/context explicitly marked.
sensing.consistency: Use raw observed w for context and feedback; its spectral derivatives for observed w_s/w_ss; use SAME estimated w_t and its spectral spatial derivatives in supplied controller channels. Same sensor rule in training and control.
sensing.noise: causal_noisy adds independent zero-mean Gaussian position-measurement noise with SD1e-5 per site per.005s sample. This is 0.067% of nominal.015 reference amplitude, a declared challenge rather than generic sensor specification.
sensing.random_streams: Row Gaussian initialization seed732–736 and separate sensor seeds100000+row_seed; draw/store innovations at every sample, includingzero-noiseconditions. Branches clone the RNG at80s, giving common innovations on overlapping time indices but own plant observations. Noisy five-seed variation combines row and noise variation; it is not a crossed factorial test.
sensing.truth: Actual w,w_t,clean spatial channels and F may be saved for evaluator only. No evaluator clean filter/rate or physical F may feed the learner/controller.

learning.law: Rdot=vv^T-R/4; qdot=-10000*(qR-(qRq^T)q), all5unitrowentriesfree at eachsite; Gaussian initialization only
learning.implementation: Previously independently validated compiled kernel, same exact held-v R(t), RK4 q, endpoint unit normalization, >=4subdivisions with eta*ds*max_endpoint_trace<=.25; cap10000 per update. No coefficient residual fitting, derivative ties, oracle targets, Fourier, eigenvector initialization, or parameter sweeps.
learning.evaluation_boundary: Physical field F is evaluated at CLEAN actual context for recovery; physical row on noisy secants is a reference, not a guaranteed lower bound.

branching.timing: Clone before sensing/assimilating t80. Both first commands use identical trained pre-update q. Adaptive continues learning; frozen q bitwise fixed, diagnosticR may evolve. Each arm independent budgets and observations.
branching.final: Recordt100 without a further learner/plant update; stopped attempted sample retained. Exclude all unapplied commands from task/control metrics.

assessment.training_rule: All above near-identification conditions must hold for an individual run to be described as tracking after near-identification. These are offline evaluator labels only, never stopping/gating/selection; every branch runs even if they fail. Finite error thresholds are not a convergence theorem.
assessment.comparison: Use own-trajectory adaptive/frozen metrics over identical observed horizons; never compare unequal-duration RMS as if matched. If both full/late intervals exist comparethose; otherwise recordfailure/censoredinterval. Equal success can support readout; tracking advantage requires lower physical and task error after qualifiedtraining. Report every seed and condition; no favorable subset replacesall-seed summaries.

audit.field: Physical row-projector error at actualcleancontext, mean/median/p95/p99/max/worstsite, initial-row shadow at samecontexts. Unit/sign alignment evaluator only.
audit.covariance: Independently reconstruct observed secants andR; compare q with observed empiricalbottom, observedbottom with physicalF, evaluatorcleancontextbottom with physicalF, spectra/gaps/activity. CleanR uses the same valid-context update mask, not extra unavailablestartupdata. Gaps alone prove no physical identification.
audit.sensor: Independently replay same polynomial filter on truew evaluatoronly. Rateerror=cleanfitbias+noisecontribution; retain squared terms/crossmoment instead of addingRMS. Record actual totalbias/variance and theoretical weight-norm noise variance.
audit.readout: Compare learned rawcompletion with physicalF completion using identical observed suppliedrates (fielderror), and separately compare physicalF completion on observed versus cleanrates/cleanfeedback (sensingerror). Report applied vsraw/clipped, guarddenominators andinputeffort.
audit.task: Globaltime-space RMS of TRUEw minusreference; observed trackingerror separate. Finalendpoint/failedunusedcommands excluded.
audit.independent_numerics: Check representative literal jointq/R ODE intervals including any stiffcase, parentnativehashes, stageorder, full branchstate, frozen constancy, plant andinputtransitions. No runner imports in independent scientific audit.

refinement.scope: Fixed seed732, ideal andcausal_clean at.005,.0025,.00125. Halvingwholeloopdt changes sampling/control and causal-fit weights as well asintegration; not pureODE solver-order test. No noisy refinement, becausefixed-per-sample noise at differing sample rates changesinformationrate.
refinement.metrics: Common-grid state/input/field comparisons, samephysicalwindows, branchranking, allthresholds andcoverage.
refinement.flags: Retain relativechange>10% whenmetricmagnitude>1e-6; absolutechange>1e-5 in meanfield or>1e-4 in taskRMS. Reportbothsuccessivehalvings andtrend, no automaticextra refinement or tolerance relaxation.

execution.failure: Incremental1srawchunks, periodic5sstatecheckpoints, complete preattempt+failedobservation+postfailurestate. Failed/truncated/unattemptedcases explicitly retained; no restarts or settingchanges afteroutcomes except separatelydeclared implementation repairs justified by evidence.

preservation: Rawclean/observedcontexts andsensornoise, validity, qpre/post,secants,suppliedrates/targets,commands/guard/clip, R snapshots, histories/RNG, sources/config/compilerbinary/environment/commitdirtybaseline andhashes. New identities do not recover missing historical records.
publication: Private validation only. No automatic manuscript/supplement replacement, commit, push or external upload.
